shots.seen: Uncle seated mid-frame in pale kurta and grey shawl, eyes shadowed; barred window at right with passing light; chain at left, knee blurred bottom-left; lower third of the frame is a dark flat berth with the caption.
problems: Frame is very dark and soft: almost no crisp edges, torso is a pale flat triangle, bottom 35% is dead.
shots.fix: Add ink outlines and brighter rexine/berth detail, a clarity pass, lift the lamp pool onto the berth and fill the lower third with seat stitching/bag.

shots.seen: One-point aisle with tube lights, side berths, curtains on the left and a green exit lamp; sleepers read as coloured blocks.
problems: Subject (aisle) only ~20% tall, sleepers are boxes, feet are hard to read, contrast low.
shots.fix: Make the aisle taller in frame, give berth blocks darker ink edges and blanket folds, brighter tube pool on the floor.

shots.seen: Yellowed ticket with PNR, S7 and 14-06-2014 readable; the hand is a stubby thumb shape on the right that reads more like a foot than fingers.
problems: Hand/arm silhouette is weak; background is soft blur with too many colours.
shots.fix: Reduce colour bins in the blurred bg, outline the hand and sleeve, add visible fingers curling over the ticket edge.

shots.seen: Uncle close, head filling the upper half, eyes in shadow, blue lamp bloom behind; body below the chin is nearly black.
problems: Torso invisible, large empty regions, face is soft.
shots.fix: Brighten the kurta/shawl with window rim, add outline, fill background with bars and window.

shots.seen: Dim bay with a flickering tube fixture on top, fog window, uncle small and almost invisible.
problems: Subject only ~5% tall: the stillness is felt but the uncle is lost in the dark.
shots.fix: Enlarge and light the uncle, brighten the fog window so the black fog reads, keep the tube flicker.

shots.seen: Uncle lies on his side under a maroon blanket, head left on a pillow, two glints at the eyes; face is a dark blob.
problems: Face unreadable, glints float, empty upper area.
shots.fix: Light the lying face (key from the lamp), larger head, put glints exactly on the eyes.

shots.seen: Berth stacks with sleepers and one dangling hand with a yellow ticket per bay; hands small, dark scene.
problems: Only one hand/ticket per frame reads, low contrast.
shots.fix: Scale hands up, brighten tickets, add a second row of hands, more berth outlines.

shots.seen: Yellow window with the Itarsi board partly hidden by bars and the uncle; pale flat kurta triangle, warm wash.
problems: Over-warm, board cropped, colours too many.
shots.fix: Move the board up and enlarge, tame the wash, keep bars thin.

shots.seen: Dim bay with an empty seat and shawl, then lids closing to black with a faint blue glow.
problems: Last keyframe is almost black by design; first two lack a readable subject.
shots.fix: Make the empty seat and shawl larger and lit in the first half; keep the faint lamp glow in the silence.

shots.seen: Large window with a cool platform and blurred board streaking; frame is wide and noisy in colour.
problems: Board is a blur, too many hues, no strong focal.
shots.fix: Make the BHOPAL board bigger and legible at the hit, reduce palette to blue plus white.

shots.seen: Same framing as s3, ticket paler then yellowing, hand again stubby.
shots.fix: Same hand fix; keep the age animation.

shots.seen: Narrator seated like the uncle, dark and soft, matches s1 framing.
problems: Same darkness as s1, face unreadable.
shots.fix: Same brightening as s1; make the narrator's blue shirt visible.
